scripts.build: curl https://sh.rustup.rs -sSf | sh -s -- -y --default-toolchain stable --profile minimal 2>/dev/null; . "$HOME/.cargo/env"; cargo install wasm-pack --locked 2>/dev/null || true; wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir www/pkg
scripts.dev: wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir www/pkg && npx serve www
